g.text: SECTION N-S THROUGH H-201 / PIPE RACK / C-201 (AREA 200)
1. Elevations in metres; grade (HPP) EL 100.000. Section looking WEST (north to the right).
2. Items in front of / at the section plane solid; items beyond shown dashed grey.
3. Nozzle elevations approximate (FEED) - from tray spacing 0.61 / 0.76 m per sizing.
4. Rack tiers TOS EL 106.0 / 108.5 / 111.0; air coolers on structure above tier 3.
5. C-201 bottom T/L EL 110.0 for P-204 NPSH (VR 366 C, quench).
6. Ejector condensers on ST-201 >= 10.4 m above hotwell D-201 (barometric legs).
Equipment shown: E 158 to section plane E 204; faint = more than 40 m beyond plane
